svg.title: Zcash addresses and pools
svg.desc: Simplified infographic. A transparent address (t1) pays into the public Transparent pool. A Sapling address (zs1) pays into the hidden Sapling pool. A unified address (u1) holds several receivers; the sender uses the first it supports: 1 Ironwood (new, hidden), 2 Sapling (hidden), 3 Transparent (public). The older Orchard pool is spend only. Moving money between public and hidden pools makes the amount visible. Three checks before sending.
